No drop shadow on any shell surface. Blur only over windows.
#rail is defined once. Nothing owns a private
gradient. Colour says what, opacity says when.
Widths never change, so the underline lands
under the same glyph every time. It samples
the surface's axis, so it is brand, not decoration.
